description: This file contains unit tests for the OpenClaw configuration file handling code in a macOS environment. It verifies behavior such as environment variable overrides, remote gateway URL parsing and modification, configuration saving with audit logs, and detection of out-of-band configuration changes.

classes.name: OpenClawConfigFileTests
classes.description: A suite of unit tests for validating the behavior of OpenClaw configuration file handling in various scenarios.

methods.name: makeConfigOverridePath
methods.description: Creates a temporary path for OpenClaw configuration override JSON file.

methods.name: `config path respects env override`
methods.description: Verifies that the configuration file path respects the environment variable override.

methods.name: `remote gateway port parses and matches host`
methods.description: Tests parsing the remote gateway URL to extract the port and matching the host.

methods.name: `set remote gateway url preserves scheme`
methods.description: Ensures that updating the remote gateway URL maintains the URL scheme.

methods.name: `clear remote gateway url removes only url field`
methods.description: Checks that clearing the remote gateway URL only removes the URL field, preserving other config fields.

methods.name: `state dir override sets config path`
methods.description: Verifies that setting the state directory environment variable influences the config file path accordingly.

methods.name: `save dict appends config audit log`
methods.description: Ensures the saving of config dict appends an audit log with correct metadata.

methods.name: `load dict audits suspicious out-of-band clobbers`
methods.description: Checks that loading a config with suspicious modifications triggers audit and detection of out-of-band changes.
